terms.name: Requirement
terms.definition: A request with explicit acceptance criteria.

sourceRefs.quote: An explicit Requirement has acceptance criteria and targets a Product.

terms.name: Product
terms.definition: A product targeted by a requirement.

sourceRefs.quote: An explicit Requirement has acceptance criteria and targets a Product.
A Component has a stable Version.

terms.name: Version
terms.definition: A stable version identity for a component.

sourceRefs.quote: A Component has a stable Version.

terms.name: Build
terms.definition: A build record tied to source revision and component version.

sourceRefs.quote: A Build is created from a source revision and a Component Version.

terms.name: TestRun
terms.definition: An actual test execution associated with a build.

terms.name: Artifact
terms.definition: A produced file or package with a digest.

sourceRefs.quote: An Artifact is produced by a Build and carries a SHA-256 digest.

terms.name: Release
terms.definition: A candidate or published bundle that must carry test and security evidence.

sourceRefs.quote: A Release contains Artifacts and must be linked to test and security evidence before it is eligible for publication.
